visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A hand with light-colored fingernails holds a pistachio gelato cone featuring a waffle base and a thick, nutty green topping. In the background, staff members in white t-shirts and caps stand behind a counter with Italian text and diagrams about gelato making. (2) The scene transitions to a wide shot of the shop's seating area. Multiple customers are seated at wooden tables against a gray, industrial-style concrete wall that features a neon 'ULTRA-FRESH' sign. The lighting is warm and bright. (3) A digital menu board is displayed, listing various gelato flavors like 'RISO DI CECCU' and 'PISTACHIOTTELLA' alongside prices in Korean Won. (4) Behind the counter, staff members are seen serving customers. A clear glass display case contains diverse gelato containers. A glass dispenser of lemon-infused water sits on the counter alongside napkins and wooden stirrers. (5) A young woman with long dark hair, wearing a white translucent shirt, holds the pistachio gelato cone. She looks directly at the camera, takes a large bite, and displays a satisfied facial expression. (6) A final close-up shows a wooden spoon scooping into the pistachio gelato, highlighting its soft, creamy texture and the dense topping of crushed nuts.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 韓國聖水洞排隊名店. [Logo]: maman gelato. (2) [Subtitle]: 當天下大雨所以人潮少很多. (3) [Subtitle]: 櫃檯小小的 還有附上檸檬水跟濕紙巾. (4) [Subtitle]: 期待已久的開心果 我點的是S size 還一定要的餅乾甜筒. (5) [Subtitle]: 製作過程 拉絲軟綿的義大利冰淇淋. (6) [Subtitle]: 開心果超濃超好吃. (7) [Subtitle]: 他最多可以用3球 但是太多了 就買小的. (8) [Subtitle]: *買的當天下大雨 大概只排了十分鐘*. (9) [Subtitle]: 開心果控一定要吃. (10) [Subtitle]: 店家還有很多口味 聽說抹茶很熱門 大家有空去吃看看吧.
